summary: Tests-only phase for issue #39 (adopt generated OpenAPI client + enforce solver parity). Committed: (1) solver parity harness SolverParityCorpusTests.swift + committed seed corpus fixture (12 hand-computed cases: exact match, weight asymmetry incl. the Elixir doctest 0.205, two tie variants, three exclusion variants, zero-weight-optional, multi-channel) with corpus-integrity self-checks (schema version, unique ids, required-category coverage); (2) PaletteAPIWireContractTests.swift, the permanent wire-contract harness pinning /api/v1 paths, headers, bearer handling, status mapping, and envelope shapes so the generated-client migration is verified behavior-preserving; (3) docs/solver-parity-corpus.md documenting corpus location/format/refresh and the /api/v1 wire-shape notes for the migration PR description. Corpus arithmetic was independently cross-checked with a Python re-implementation of the documented WeightedSquaredError semantics (12/12 cases, 0 problems). swift test could NOT be executed in this container: no Swift toolchain is installed (swift: command not found), so all runnable-test criteria are recorded as skipped rather than inferred green. Implementation deliverables (swift-openapi-generator/runtime migration, README section, PR description) belong to the follow-up implementation run per phase rules; this run only records their verification harness.
